description: Two-storey front extension, part single-storey/part two-storey rear extension involving the demolition of the existing conservatory, loft conversion including the erection of a rear dormer, raising of the ridge height and hipped to gable roof conversion, installation of front roof lights, and associated landscaping alterations.
decision_conditions: The proposed first-floor rear extension, by reason of its excessive scale, depth, siting and close proximity to the shared boundary with No. 28 Old Park View, would result in an unacceptably overbearing impact,  an increased sense of enclosure, and a significant loss of outlook and sunlight when viewed from No.28 Old Park View. The proposal would therefore cause significant harm to neighbouring residential amenity and would be contrary to Section 12 of the National Planning Policy Framework (2026), Policies D4 and D5 of the London Plan (2021), Policy CP30 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), and Policies DMD 11 and DMD 37 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).
